python_surfaces.honest_automation_surface: NO headless/scriptable automation path exists in this install. There is no console/batch/socket-automation executable, no command-line import/export driver, zero .pyd, zero .py, an EMPTY PythonLib dir, and the only executables are the GUI app, its QtWebEngineProcess helper, and the uninstaller. The embedded CPython 3.7 is stdlib-only (.pyc in python37.zip). Any MD drape work is INTERACTIVE via the GUI (driven by an operator or by desktop/UI automation such as cua). Do NOT fabricate a CLI/script automation surface that is not on disk.

recipe_spec.name: Shorewake Garment Drape Loop (48-panel -> MD -> UE) — Melodia Universal Garment seam

source_mesh.authoritative_grouping: Saved/Audit/melusina_lookdev/night_pkg_2026-08-31/garment_layers_manifest.json (48 panels -> 10 garment material layers: M_Bodice_Torso/Front/Side/Upper, M_Collar, M_Shoulder_Trim, M_Shoulder_Ornament, M_Sleeve, M_Underskirt, M_Skirt_Full)

loop_steps.action: Split or keep as-is per the garment_layers_manifest 48->10 layer grouping. For MD draping, the dress must be un-stuffed/de-capped into sewable panels: MD ingests OBJ/FBX/Alembic.
loop_steps.bakegate: Dry-run: keep the slotted OBJ as the canonical source; MD project saved as .zpac (source-of-truth MD garment file) in Saved/Audit/universal_garment/md_project/.

loop_steps.phase: Import into MD (INTERACTIVE — no automation path)
loop_steps.action: In MD GUI: Import the panel OBJ -> auto-arrange into 2D patterns -> assign fabric properties per the 10 cymatic garment layers (bodice charmeuse/satin, skirt silk sheet, collar/ornament rigid lace). MD physics fabric presets map 1:1 onto the 10 garment materials.
loop_steps.note: Because no headless path exists, this step requires an operator session or desktop UI automation; it CANNOT be scripted against this install.

loop_steps.input: Pattern + mannequin (Melusina avatar or scaled proxy)
loop_steps.action: MD drape simulation on the bodied silhouette. Save .zpac + export simulated mesh.
loop_steps.note: Simulation result is a draped, deformed mesh — the 'true drape' that replaces/augments the authored 48-panel silhouette.

loop_steps.action: Export the draped result. Options (all engine libraries verified on disk): USD ('Export garment simulation data to USD', Single/Multi Objects, Unified UV Coordinates), FBX (libfbxsdk.dll), OBJ, Alembic (Alembic.dll).
loop_steps.recommended: FBX primary for UE import (UBUCloth/Interchange friendly); USD secondary where flap-of-animation/sim cache matters.

loop_steps.action: Import via UE Interchange (FBX) or the engine USD importer (USD). Hook result mesh into the verified small master family M_Master_Nikki / M_Universal_Enhanced_Fabric / M_Master_Toon_Universal_Alpha with per-layer MIs (per CYMATIC_GARMENT_NIKKI_PIPELINE 2026-09-02 SS4 naming).
loop_steps.constraints: Never touch Content/**/*.uasset by script; editor-gated. The draped mesh must keep Unity-Forward (MD +Y up / UE Z-up handedness on import).
